cohort: Primiparous women who delivered by cesarean section after viable gestation at a tertiary care center in South Tamil Nadu, India between March 2022 and February 2023.
finding: The cesarean section rate among primiparous women was 25.84%, with the most common indication being non-reassuring fetal heart rate/fetal distress (31.61%) followed by Cephalopelvic disproportion (22.96%).
gest_age: Viable gestation (preterm, term, and postdated pregnancies were included)
followup_time: The study period was from March 2022 to February 2023, with postoperative follow-up mentioned but not a specific duration.
